# libs/bonnie-cms — CLAUDE.md

Angular CMS admin UI library (`@candy-kingdom/bonnie-cms`). See the root `CLAUDE.md` for full project context.

## Critical rule

**Never edit `src/lib/generated/`** — files there are auto-generated by `apps/marcy-gen` from C# source. Run `dotnet run --project apps/marcy-gen` to regenerate.

## Public API

`src/index.ts` re-exports all sub-folder barrels. When adding a new export, add it to the **sub-folder's `index.ts`** — the root barrel picks it up automatically.

## Adding a bone editor

1. Create a new component class extending `BoneEditorBaseComponent<TBone>`.
2. Implement `getPresets(): ContentPreset<TBone>[]` for style switching.
3. Export from `src/lib/bone-editors/index.ts`.

```typescript
@Component({ selector: 'app-my-bone-editor', /* ... */ })
export class MyBoneEditorComponent extends BoneEditorBaseComponent<MyBone> {
  getPresets(): ContentPreset<MyBone>[] {
    return [
      createPreset({ title: 'Default', style: MyBoneStyle.default }),
    ];
  }
}
```

Access the bone in the template as `bone()` and in TypeScript as `this.bone()`. The `bone` property is a `WritableSignal<TBone>`.

## BoneEditorMap

Register editor components in a `BoneEditorMap` in the consuming app — not in this library:

```typescript
// In the consuming app
export const AdminBoneMap: BoneEditorMap = new Map([
  ['my-bone', MyBoneEditorComponent],
]);
```

## Adding a form component

Form components extend `FormBaseComponent<TData>` and use `EditableDirective` as a host directive:

```typescript
@Component({
  hostDirectives: [{ directive: EditableDirective, inputs: ['boncEditable'], outputs: ['saved'] }],
})
export class MyFormComponent extends FormBaseComponent<MyData> {
  readonly ed = inject(EditableDirective<MyData>);
}
```

Export from `src/lib/forms/index.ts`.

## EditableDirective

The core data binding primitive. It tracks original vs. current value and exposes `isDirty`. Wrap any editable UI in it:

```html
<div [boncEditable]="currentValue" (saved)="onSave($event)" (cancelled)="onCancel()">
  <!-- editing UI -->
</div>
```

## Data services

Inject via constructor — both services use `API_BASE_URL` token:

```typescript
providers: [{ provide: API_BASE_URL, useValue: environment.apiUrl }]
```

- `DataService` — public read (pages, views, settings)
- `AdminDataService` — admin read/write (requires auth on the server side)

## Signals pattern

Same as `libs/bonnie` — signals only, no decorators. Templates call signals with `()`.

## Control flow

Use `@if` / `@for` — never `*ngIf` / `*ngFor`.

## Build

```bash
npx nx build bonnie-cms
npx nx lint bonnie-cms
```
